independent_cpu_run.scope: Owned temporary tiny files only; actual mmap/mincore/preadv/fadvise plus bounded mocked error/identity/credential/deadline fixtures. No real model, Store or other cache target.

reviewed.finite_manifest: Nonempty explicit list maximum1024; absolute roots/directories; regular files and unique dev/inode; no recursive discovery. Final symlink/FIFO/outside-root/FD redirection rejected before cache operation.
reviewed.trust: Full identity UID map, euid/fsuid equality, file owner or root with effective CAP_FOWNER; checked around mincore. Root alone is not assumed sufficient. Real permission/call errors propagate.
reviewed.query: Read-only non-populating mmap+mincore, no page dereference/pread warming in query. Empty file never maps and cannot be declared hot.
reviewed.eviction: Per-file O_RDONLY fadvise DONTNEED acknowledgement is not admission; actual subsequent resident count controls admission. No global drop_caches.
reviewed.warming: Bounded8MiB buffer and complete explicit-file preadv; short reads and errors fail. Actual final residency must be full.
reviewed.identity_race: FD/path dev/inode/size/mtime/uid and canonical fd target checked before and after operations, with final all-file identity check; detected mutation rejects.
reviewed.deadlines: Finite monotonic deadline checked around calls and final return. Overrun after read cannot return admission. mincore/munmap error preserves original primary exception.
reviewed.unchanged_scope: No modifications by reviewer; no Git, GPU, container, model or Store operations.

limitations: Cooperative syscall checks are not hard interruption: external independent guardian required for hard runtime bound.
mincore reports sequential local client-page-cache snapshots, not stable residency for a later request or an atomic simultaneous snapshot of all files.
NFS server cache and physical disk cache remain uncontrolled. Ownership/map assumptions intentionally fail closed outside full identity UID mapping.

Allowed roots are a trusted caller-supplied finite boundary, not a standalone authorization system. Formal protocol, exact model input inventory, common phase budget, actor/cache lifetime and actual runner consumption require separate review.
No formal experiment/admission/model-cache operation or GPU validation performed; these eleven tests do not prove real checkpoint eviction or warming.
